description: Type objectAccessControls.delete's HTTP 403 when the entry is the object owner's own OWNER ACL ('The owner of the resource is required to have OWNER access.'). It surfaced as a generic Forbidden, indistinguishable from a missing permission.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The ACL entry is the object owner's OWNER grant, which Cloud Storage never removes (HTTP 403). Not retryable.

message.includes: owner of the resource is required to have OWNER access
